title: EVE burst error

routes.title: まりな編
routes.notes: Houjou Marina's investigation thread (bodyguard/spy protecting ambassador's daughter Mayako Midou). Story begins December 2nd, one calendar day before Kojiro's thread starts. This is NOT a heroine route in the usual sense: the game is a command-based dual-protagonist adventure ('Multi-Site System') and the player freely switches between Marina and Kojiro during investigation scenes. Progress in one thread is frequently gated behind reaching a specific flag in the other thread (sources describe this with capital-letter 'block' markers and lowercase 'unlock' markers on their flowcharts, plus explicit 'サイトチェンジ' (switch site) prompts in the walkthrough text). Both sources organize this thread by calendar date (12/2 through 12/8) rather than by named chapters.

routes.title: 小次郎編
routes.notes: Amagi Kojiro's investigation thread (private detective hired to recover a painting, drawn into a murder case). Begins December 3rd. The 'prerequisites: [marina]' edge is soft/calendar-based, not a hard story lock: the game opens on Marina's Dec 2 content and Kojiro's Dec 3 content becomes available afterward, but from that point on the two threads interleave freely (the player is directed back and forth between them scene by scene per the flowchart's block/unlock notation) rather than one being fully completed before the other starts. A step-by-step guide must interleave marina and kojiro day-by-day rather than presenting them as fully sequential routes. Both threads run in parallel through December 8th.

routes.title: テラー編
routes.notes: The two protagonist threads converge into the single shared finale ('テラー編') on December 9. The directly inspected R walkthrough gives one culprit-input sequence after optional incident recaps: 孔→ディーブ, 二階堂→真弥子, ディーブ→真弥子, アクア→真弥子, 御堂→真弥子, then 推理を確定する. Correct answers award 犯人推理成功, テラー編：12月9日クリア, and 事件解決. The prior research split this into provisional and true-ending sections, but the two primary sources do not support a separate replay/true route, so that inferred split has been removed.
routes.portrait_note: left empty per instructions — no single character maps to this convergence chapter

sources.title: EVE-burst error 非公式完全攻略ガイド (MYST / Sacred Hill) — 攻略チャート index, with sub-pages guide01.html–guide07.html covering 12月2日–12月8,9日
sources.notes: Complete day-by-day flowchart-style walkthrough covering both Marina and Kojiro threads from Dec 2 through the Dec 8-9 finale, including the 'multi-site system' block/unlock notation, zapping markers, and a downloadable Excel full-game chart. Written primarily against the original Windows release but the site explicitly also references EVE burst error R. Verified pages: index (guide.html), guide01.html (12/2, Marina opening), guide02.html (12/3, both threads), guide05.html (12/6, database/embassy/ship sequences with zapping sync points), guide07.html (12/8-9 finale, five-murder-case breakdown). To be used as PRIMARY source #1 for route flow, scenario-switch points, and the finale's culprit/case breakdown. The finale source material does not document a separate provisional/true-ending route split; the guide therefore models one テラー編 finale.

sources.title: PSV EVE burst error R 攻略 トップページ — Almagest (Seesaa blog), 22-part numbered series from https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440678963.html (Part 1) through https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440745361.html (Part 22)
sources.notes: Complete command-level (話す/移動する/見る・調べる) walkthrough of EVE burst error R for PS Vita, organized by day and by thread (Kojiro/Marina/Terror), including trophy checklist and platinum-trophy notes. The author explicitly states this walkthrough also applies to the Nintendo Switch release (Oct 2018) — i.e. it targets the same content as our target platform. Verified parts: Part 1 (440678963, 12/3 Kojiro opening), Part 18 (440739015, 12/7 Marina, ship sequences, explicit 'small次郎編にサイトチェンジ' site-change marker), Part 22 (440745361, 12/9 Terror finale, culprit-guessing answers for all 5 murders, trophy list). To be used as PRIMARY source #2, especially for confirming the target-version (R/Switch) content and the exact culprit-quiz answers. Does not document traditional mid-story 'bad end' game-over screens in the parts checked — see disagreements/notes on bad-end structure below.

sources.title: EVE burst error攻略サイト | EVE1 - ゲームライン
sources.notes: Supplementary/tertiary Japanese source. Confirmed to organize its walkthrough by calendar date (12/2-12/9) like the other two sources, and links to companion guides for the sequels EVE rebirth terror (EVE2) / EVE ghost enemies (EVE3), confirming this site covers EVE1 (burst error) specifically. Individual date sub-pages returned server errors (503) during this research pass and were not fully read — not fully verified as complete. Should be treated as a cross-check source only, not a primary source, unless re-fetched successfully during guide writing.

disagreements: 1) 'Routes' are not heroine routes: EVE burst error is one dual-protagonist Multi-Site story. Marina and Kojiro interleave, then converge into テラー編. 2) The prior research modeled a separate 'terror_provisional' followed by 'terror_true'. Fresh author re-check on 2026-09-25 found that split was not supported by either primary source. Set B's R walkthrough (Part 22) gives a single December 9 Terror sequence: optional incident recaps, five culprit answers, 推理を確定する, then trophies 犯人推理成功 / テラー編：12月9日クリア / 事件解決. Set A likewise describes the five cases and their culprits but does not document a separate first ending followed by a replay. The unsupported split has therefore been removed; the finale is one `terror` section. 3) The Switch target is covered directly by Set B: its walkthrough is for EVE burst error R and its guide index explicitly states applicability to the Nintendo Switch release. Independent contemporary release coverage describes the 2018 Switch edition as the port of the 2016 Vita/PC R release. 4) No primary source inspected documents conventional mid-scenario bad-end/game-over branches; do not invent them. 5) This correction changes route structure/assembly, so both structural and accuracy review are invalidated for the final guide content.
